label: 9. You say that I sent a code to Novel but

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You say that I sent a code to Novel but

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I have no recollection of this.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I don't remember half of what happened today.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Not only that, but the key word in the code, Vapaus, has been banned.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Perhaps I came about the word Vapaus somehow,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and after nothing came up in the Ark database,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I infiltrated the Central Government database.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: After which I was caught, and summarily executed.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I believe that's the correct order of events, yes?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: This is something I would have done.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But you incinerated your brain before you died.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I must have known some very important information.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Something that didn't have to do with the hacking.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Do you know what it is?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: If you're not comfortable sharing it with me, I don't blame you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You were killed. How are you alive right now?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It must have something to do with the code I left behind.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: There are nanomachines in a Nikke's brain.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Think of them as microscopic machines meant to back up data.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I can give you the long version or the short version.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You choose.
Choose to listen to the detailed explanation.
Choose to listen to the basic explanation.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: The official name is NIMPH.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's short for Neuro-Implanted Machine for the Protection of Humans.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What about it?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: A memory wipe directly stimulates the brain into severing synaptic connections.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You must have seen cases where combat data or other memories were retained.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yeah, I've seen it.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: This indicates that you can control the information in your brain at will.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: NIMPH is what makes that possible.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: There are three things that NIMPH does.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Erase, remember and write.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: The NIMPH implanted in a Nikke's brain can break the synaptic connection

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: while continuing to back up the latest state of the synapsis.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You know what autosave is?
The system when a video game saves automatically?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: In a fresh brain where there has been a memory wipe,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: the memory backed up by NIMPH is overwritten.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: So long as there is no physical trauma to the brain,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: this process can go on infinitely.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: The official name is NIMPH.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: The nanomachines implanted in a Nikke's brain

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: erases information from the brain and allows it to be remembered and written.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Think of it as a backup storage.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Or always enabling autosave.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: In a fresh brain where there has been a memory wipe,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: the memory backed up by NIMPH is overwritten.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: So long as there is no physical trauma to the brain,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: this process can go on infinitely.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: But your head was splattered.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Your brain was physically damaged, so how did you survive?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: it's not an easy thing to talk about.
You don't have to tell us if it makes you uncomfortable.
I want to know.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: There we go.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: But please make sure to keep this a secret.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Protocol squads have safeguards in their brains

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: to prevent corruption or brain scans from other entities.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I believe when I 'bit the bullet' so to speak, my safeguard was the only thing ejected,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: leaving my actual brain undamaged.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Even if that's true, that doesn't mean they'll just look past the fact you hacked into the database.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Consider it a benefit of being part of Protocol.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: We manage all data within the ark and support Enik.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I think they let it slide.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It means I'm irreplaceable.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're important to them.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Something like that.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But what about when you incinerated your brain?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: The brain has to burn for at least a minute before any real damage occurs.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: That's when the NIMPH starts to burn, at which point you are well and truly dead.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I believe they killed me just after I had commenced the incineration process.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: So only a part of the brain was damaged.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Then, after the memory wipe, it seems my brain reset itself using the backed-up memory.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Any Nikke who goes through a memory wipe is as good as dead.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: All information in the brain is lost, so the backed up information can all be considered brand new information.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: How can you call that surviving?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The original 'you' is dead.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It all depends on your perception.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Life is unique. If you believe we only live once, then yes,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: a memory wipe is like dying.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: However, if you feel life is a compilation of different information, then

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: it's not like that at all.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: And what do you think?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I can't tell you.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's obvious you will allow your thoughts to be influenced by other people's answer.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Therefore, I will not respond.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You must come to your own conclusion.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Now, back to the topic at hand.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: "Vapaus brings an end to a Nikke's immortality.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It destroys the nanomachines in the Nikke's brain and frees them from the bondage of immortality."

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I think we can take the message literally.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: We don't know what Vapaus is, but we can infer that it kills the NIMPH in a Nikke's brain.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: In other words,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: the brain loses its ability to use NIMPH as a backup.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Thereby closing the loop,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and thus ending a Nikke's "immortality".

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Naturally, memory wipes will be of no effect either.
